guideline: Participants assessed 450 randomly selected questions using a 5-point Likert scale across four dimensions: (1) readability; (2) ease of answering prior to using a web search engine; (3) ease of answering after conducting a web search; and (4) overall clarity (including lack of ambiguity)
- Participants rated questions on a 5-point Likert scale across four dimensions before and after web searches

ease of answering after conducting a web search

overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs on temporal question answering using the ComplexTempQA dataset. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and dataset capitalization. The paper evaluates NLG (question answering) but does not use LLMs as judges - only as generators. Human evaluation was conducted with clear criteria and methodology.
